summary: This bill establishes an Animal Cruelty Crimes Section within the Department of Justice to enforce federal animal cruelty laws and requires annual reports to Congress on related investigations and prosecutions.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a dedicated Animal Cruelty Crimes Section within the Department of Justice to enforce federal animal cruelty laws. This action aims to strengthen the prosecution and investigation of these crimes, indicating a move towards stricter enforcement within a specific area of criminal justice.
